name: pan-flowmapper
description: Offline PAN-OS config flow tracer: tests and build helpers

scripts.samples: node -e "for (const d of ['samples/routes','samples/scope-conflict']) require('fs').mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true})" && node samples/generate_samples.mjs && node samples/generate_decom.mjs && node samples/generate_phase3.mjs && node samples/generate_scope.mjs
scripts.test: node tests/test_core.mjs && node tests/test_fcr_path.mjs && node tests/test_phase3.mjs && node tests/test_scope.mjs && node tests/test_decom.mjs && node tests/test_ui.mjs && node tests/test_decom_ui.mjs
scripts.test:core: node tests/test_core.mjs && node tests/test_fcr_path.mjs && node tests/test_phase3.mjs && node tests/test_scope.mjs && node tests/test_decom.mjs

author: PAAT maintainers
